name: crypto cipher streaming blocks
source: import { Buffer } from 'node:buffer'; import { createCipheriv } from 'node:crypto'; function main(): void { const cipher = createCipheriv('aes-256-cbc', Buffer.alloc(32), Buffer.alloc(16)); const first = cipher.update('abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz012345'); const last = cipher.final(); console.log(first.length, last.length, Buffer.concat([first, last]).length); }
